diagnostics.message: is declared workflow-scoped AND advertised by a capability planner. The two say opposite things about whether the parser may propose this kind: workflow-scoped means it is never advertised and never accepted from a parse, while plannerAdvertisedBy records that a planner does put it in the advertised roster. Settle it here — either the kind is a free verb or it is workflow-invocable, and the runtime must not have to guess.
